```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
samples <- read.delim(file.path(project_folder, sample_file), comment.char = "#")
```

# Sample summary

```{r sample-summary, results='asis'}
n_samples <- length(unique(samples$sample_id))
assembly_ids <- unique(unlist(strsplit(samples$assembly_ids, ",\\s*")))

assembly_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  assembly_id = assembly_ids,
  n_samples = sapply(assembly_ids, function(a) sum(grepl(a, samples$assembly_ids))),
  samples = sapply(assembly_ids, function(a) {
    paste(samples$sample_id[grepl(a, samples$assembly_ids)], collapse = ", ")
  })
)

cat(sprintf("**%d** unique samples, grouped into **%d** assemblies.\n\n", n_samples, length(assembly_ids)))
preview_table(assembly_summary, n = nrow(assembly_summary), caption = "Samples per assembly")
```

# Raw read QC (FastQC)

```{r fastqc-summary}
reads_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "reads")
zips <- Sys.glob(file.path(reads_dir, "*_fastqc.zip"))

if (length(zips) == 0) {
  cat("_No FastQC output found yet._\n")
} else {
  fastqc_df <- purrr::map_dfr(zips, parse_fastqc_zip)
  keep_cols <- intersect(
    c("sample", "Total Sequences", "Sequence length", "%GC"),
    colnames(fastqc_df)
  )
  preview_table(fastqc_df[, keep_cols], n = nrow(fastqc_df),
                caption = "FastQC basic statistics per raw read file")
}
```

# Runtime statistics

```{r reads-runtime}
bench <- discover_benchmarks(project_folder, "reads")
runtime_table(bench, caption = "reads module: runtime and peak memory per rule")
```

